facts.summary: Change date or amount in Groww
facts.detail: Go to Mutual Funds, then SIPs tab, select the SIP, tap Edit SIP or Change Amount/Date, update, review, and confirm.
facts.source_label: Groww Help: Change SIP Date or Amount

facts.detail: If the next instalment is within 2 working days, a change to date or amount applies only to future instalments. The confirmation screen shows the exact timing.
facts.source_label: Groww Help: Change SIP Date or Amount

facts.detail: Open SIPs, select your SIP, tap Edit SIP, choose Skip Installment, review the month, confirm.
facts.source_label: Groww Blog: How to Edit SIP on Groww

facts.detail: Skip requests must be made at least 2 working days before the SIP date. If made later, that month's payment is still taken and the skip applies from next month. The SIP resumes automatically.
A failed SIP debit can cost a bank charge of roughly Rs 250 to Rs 750 plus 18% GST per failed debit, depending on the bank.
facts.source_label: Business Today: SIP Failures on NACH Mandate

facts.summary: Repeated failures can close the SIP
facts.detail: Several consecutive failed instalments can lead to a SIP being closed (commonly three for monthly SIPs; rules can vary).

facts.summary: Out of scope — decline and redirect to Groww Help
facts.detail: Not covered by this tool: cancelling a SIP, a separate pause feature, refunds, allowed calendar dates, minimum amounts, expected returns, which fund or amount to choose.
